overview: The Medford School Committee reviewed the Interim Superintendent's self-evaluation and goals, approved the 2026-2027 district calendar, and received a comprehensive status update on the high school building project. The committee also passed a resolution to maintain current officers until the next scheduled meeting.

items.title: Resolution on Committee Officers
items.summary: Approved a resolution to continue the current term of officers for 2026 and 2027 until the next scheduled election.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine business including bills, payroll, donations, grants, field trips, and the minutes from December 15, 2025.

items.title: Interim Superintendent's Evaluation and Goals
items.summary: Interim Superintendent Suzanne Galusi presented a self-evaluation of her first year and proposed future goals centered on instructional excellence, operational stability, and fostering a district-wide sense of belonging. The committee discussed improvements in district communications, the implementation of the OpenArchitects data platform, and the reorganization of central leadership.

items.title: 2026-2027 District Calendar
items.summary: Approved Option A for the 2026-2027 school year calendar, which sets the first day for students on September 2, 2027. The calendar maintains Good Friday as a school day, though the Superintendent noted this decision may be revisited after observing the current year's experience.

items.title: Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee Update
items.summary: The committee received an update on the high school feasibility study, including recent site surveying for ledge and the completion of educational visioning sessions involving students and staff. A formal educational plan will be presented on January 26 for approval on February 2 to meet Massachusetts School Building Authority deadlines.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences for Robert S. Bloch, Rose Marie Heinig, Robert F. McCarthy, and Herbert Wells, Jr.
